title_as_printed: Experimental mole fraction of water content in the coexisting gas phase.

footnotes_as_printed.u: Standard uncertainties on u are u(T) = 0.1 K, u(P) = 0.01 MPa, u(yH2O) = 0.00012.

pressure_note: Pressure of the PVT cell held constant during sampling (controlled within 0.01 MPa); the paper does not say whether it is total or gas partial pressure; taken as total cell pressure

value.col: yH2O, mole fraction of water in gas phase

composition.other_species: formation water simulated by aqueous NaHCO3, 0.23 mol/kg (molality as stated), density 1.0116 g/cm3 (Anton Paar DMA45); NaHCO3 is outside the six-ion set

notes: Printed as a matrix with T in rows and P (30-130 MPa) in columns; stacked here into one block per pressure (rule: side-by-side blocks stacked), each block a label row then six temperatures 353-453 K. The pressure of each block is set by group_rows (P.constant). yH2O defined in the Nomenclature as n(water)/[n(gas)+n(water)]; authors converted measured g/m3 to mole fraction. Gas phase contains CH4 and water only.
hold_table: liquid phase is 0.23 mol/kg NaHCO3 brine (p.337), outside the six-ion set; a zero-ion row would mislabel it as pure water (audit 2026-10-02)
